_meta.name: ETF K-12 USD Holdings — COE Fiscal Certification Scoring
_meta.purpose: Per-K-12-holding COE (County Office of Education) AB 1200 fiscal-certification scoring for the proposed ETF basket. Detector: coe_fiscal_certification.py.

data_sources.primary: California Department of Education — Interim Status Reports (https://www.cde.ca.gov/fg/fi/ir/interimstatus.asp). The CDE publishes a consolidated list of all LEAs receiving Qualified (Q) or Negative (N) certifications each interim cycle. Districts NOT appearing on the Q/N list are presumed Positive by COE.
data_sources.fcmat: FCMAT report archive (https://www.fcmat.org/fcmat-reports) cross-referenced for active fiscal-distress engagements (FHRA, AB 139 audit, management review).
data_sources.state_receiver: CDE Emergency Apportionment Loan list (Ed Code §41320 et seq.); LAO state-emergency-loan tracker.

_meta.coverage_window: FY 2024-25 First Interim (cycle ended 2024-10-31, certified Dec 2024) through FY 2025-26 Second Interim (cycle ended 2026-01-31, certified May 26, 2026 — published 2 days ago by CDE).
_methodology_notes: Trailing 4 interim cycles reviewed per district: 2024-25-Q1 (First Interim), 2024-25-Q2 (Second Interim), 2025-26-Q1 (First Interim), 2025-26-Q2 (Second Interim).

For districts not appearing on any CDE Q/N list across these 4 cycles, status is recorded as 'Positive' by implication. This is the standard convention — CDE publishes only Q and N; absence from Q/N list = COE certified Positive.
Source URLs cite the CDE consolidated cycle PDF (authoritative). Individual district COE board agenda URLs are noted where the district is on the Q/N list and a deeper trace was needed.
FCMAT 'active' = report published 2024-2025 with fiscal-distress engagement type. Old reports (transportation reviews, special-ed audits) are not 'fiscal distress' and do not trigger the FCMAT flag.

detector_result._predictive_meaning: Back-to-back Q on the two most recent cycles (2025-26 Q1 and Q2) puts River Delta on the pre-receivership trajectory analog to Sacramento City USD 2024 → 2026 path. The fact that the qualified status emerged FRESH this fiscal year (clean for 2024-25) suggests a structural deficit that materialized at FY 2025-26 budget adoption.

scored_holdings.verdict_etf_impact: EXCLUDE from ETF basket pending review. The dedicated-tax GO masking framework would normally hold the bond rating well above the IDR even at extreme distress (per SCUSD anchor: BBB+ dedicated-tax GO at BB- IDR). HOWEVER: (1) River Delta is a small district ($40.9M budget — ~1/30th of LAUSD) so the AV-base depth to support 5-notch uplift is thinner; (2) the OS language on River Delta's GO series has NOT been confirmed to include the explicit pledged-special-revenue language Fitch requires for max uplift; (3) Sacramento County Office of Education itself is now overseeing two distressed obligors (SCUSD + River Delta), raising COE-bandwidth concerns. Recommend: hold-only if dedicated-tax GO OS language confirmed AND par exposure <2% of basket; otherwise exclude.

scored_holdings._note_alpine_coe: Alpine County HAS its own COE despite tiny size (Alpine COE and Alpine County USD are co-located at the Markleeville office; CDS 02613330000000 / 02100250000000). Co-located COE+District is a structural conflict-of-interest concern for AB 1200 self-certification, but not flagged by this detector.

_universe_baseline_q_n_rate._interpretation: Baseline Q/N rate ~3-6% per cycle. Our ETF basket fire rate of 16.7% (1-of-6) is ELEVATED vs universe baseline — consistent with the basket containing a non-trivial small/mid-cap rural exposure (River Delta = small tri-county rural). The single River Delta fire is structurally explainable; not noise.

_load_bearing_anchors: SCUSD progression: 2024-25 Q1 Positive → 2024-25 Q2 Qualified → 2025-26 Q1 Negative + Fitch IDR cut from A+ to BB- on 2026-04-28. Approx 12-18 month lead time from first Q to BB- rating action. Dedicated-tax GO held BBB+ (5-notch uplift confirmed). This is the canonical fact pattern River Delta now resembles.

Pleasanton USD progression: 2024-25 Q1 Positive → 2025-26 Q1 Negative → 2025-26 Q2 Negative. Faster deterioration than SCUSD — Pleasanton went straight to N within one cycle. Suggests Q→N transition can be 6 months rather than 12-18.
Plumas USD: Q since 2023 → FCMAT engagement Dec 2024 → projected cash insolvency Aug 2025 → state receivership. ~24 month timeline from first Q to receivership in a small rural district.
